SceneConfig.EnableHint: Apply dimetric 2:1 isometric projection to this scene and its grid.
SceneConfig.TransformBackgroundHint: Also apply the isometric projection to the scene background image. When unchecked (default), the background appears undistorted.
SceneConfig.ProjectionHint: Isometric projection style. Switch to Custom to enter exact rotation/skew/ratio values.

TokenConfig.TransformTokenHint: Apply the isometric stage transform to this token. When unchecked (default), the token sprite appears undistorted regardless of stage rotation.
TokenConfig.ShowImageManipulationHint: Show the image offset/scale handles (white circle and square) and the dashed image contour when the token is selected.
TokenConfig.ShowVolumeManipulationHint: Show the 3D bounding box and the elevation handle when the token is selected.
TokenConfig.ShowElevationUnselectedHint: Display the elevation label next to the token even when it is not selected.
TokenConfig.ShadowEnabledHint: Show a ground shadow beneath this token based on its elevation.
TokenConfig.ShadowShapeHint: Shadow footprint: soft radial gradient circle or flat rectangle.
TokenConfig.ShadowRadiusHint: Shadow radius multiplier relative to the token grid size (1.0 = one grid cell radius).
TokenConfig.ShadowOpacityHint: Base opacity of the shadow at ground level (0.0–1.0).
TokenConfig.ElevLineEnabledHint: Draw a line from the token to its ground position when unselected.
TokenConfig.ElevLineDashedHint: Draw the elevation line as a dashed line instead of solid.
TokenConfig.ElevLineColorHint: Elevation line color: solid black or the controlling player's color.
TokenConfig.PresetEnabledHint: Automatically apply saved configuration when a token with this image is placed, and update the preset when you edit this token.

TileConfig.ForegroundTileHint: Treats this tile as a 3D foreground object, scaling with the grid like tokens. Disable for static background or floor tiles.
TileConfig.TransformTileHint: Apply the isometric stage transform to this tile. When unchecked (default), the tile sprite appears undistorted regardless of stage rotation.
TileConfig.ShowImageManipulationHint: Show the image offset/scale handles (white circle and square) and the dashed image contour when the tile is selected.
TileConfig.ShowVolumeManipulationHint: Show the 3D bounding box and all volume handles (size, elevation, move) when the tile is selected.
TileConfig.ShadowEnabledHint: Show a ground shadow beneath this tile based on its elevation.
TileConfig.ShadowShapeHint: Shadow footprint: soft radial gradient circle or flat rectangle.
TileConfig.ShadowRadiusHint: Shadow radius multiplier relative to the tile grid size (1.0 = one grid cell radius).
TileConfig.ShadowOpacityHint: Base opacity of the shadow at ground level (0.0–1.0).
TileConfig.HideOnFogHint: Completely hide this tile in unexplored and fogged areas. By default, previously seen tiles appear dimmed in explored fog.
TileConfig.PresetEnabledHint: Automatically apply saved configuration when a tile with this image is placed, and update the preset when you edit this tile.

WallManager.GenerateBase: Generate base walls (4 sides, full tile height)
WallManager.SelectWalls: Select walls to link — click walls on canvas to toggle
WallManager.LinkSelected: Link selected walls to this tile
WallManager.UnlinkAll: Unlink all walls (keep walls, remove association)
WallManager.NoneSelected: No walls selected. Switch to Walls layer first, or use Select Walls mode.

DefaultTokenHeight.Name: Default Token Height
DefaultTokenHeight.Hint: Default bounding box height (in grid units) for tokens without an explicit height flag.

OcclusionOpacity.Name: Occlusion Opacity
OcclusionOpacity.Hint: Alpha value for tokens occluded behind a tile volume (0 = invisible, 1 = no effect).
